race.description: Bingo @ Club Paceway Every Wednesday Pace
race.comment: HESHARLEY (4) turned in a poor effort by his standards most recently when 24 metres away in seventh over 2125m at this track. Form prior to that had been solid. The recent run not a true indication. Good enough to put himself right in the finish. LOOKIN GOOD MARGIE (10) finished second last start, beaten a head, in a nice return to form at this track over 2125m. No favours expected from this draw. Meets a comparable field and she can go right on with the job. TENNESSEE KID (1) comes right into contention after scoring last start by a nose at Bathurst over 1730m. RALLY AROUND (2) is worth some thought after his last-start fourth over 2125m at this track on August 20. Worth including in combinations.
